Context: 1. Pay Level of Government servants

If the Travelling Allowance entitlements in terms of the revised entitle ments now prescribed result in a lowering of the existing entitlements in the case of any individual, groups or classes of employees, the entitlements particularly in respect of mode of travel, class of accommodation, etc., shall not be lowered. They will instead continue to be governed by the earlier orders on the subject till such time as they become eligible, in the normal course for the higher entitlements.
